mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Concurrent M/M declines in HOUST and RSAFS, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a tight labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k M/M, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary regime that will erode the purchasing power of fixed-income assets and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y/Y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a favorable environment for industrial activity that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
